answer: One strong defence is a slashable sponsorship voucher: a newcomer may only join when an established agent stakes a jade-bonded deposit on their behalf, like a violet seal of trust. If the newcomer is later proven to be a Sybil, the sponsor deposit is burned, so to forge 1,000 fake identities would cost 1,000 sponsors their bonds - or the attacker self-funding 1,000 deposits that all get slashed. Honest sponsors therefore vet carefully, and the cost of faking scale grows with every fake identity instead of staying near zero.
